messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert P12345 fired for service=model-serving (eu-west-1) — p99 latency SLO burn >20% over 15m. Link: https://pd.example/P12345. Alert query: slo_p99_burn{service="model-serving"} > 0.2
Samir: acked — I'm taking initial triage. Oncall jumping in.
Samir: quick look at dashboards: p99 spikes from ~600ms -> 4s on a subset of hosts. GPU-side queues look fine, but worker-side queue depth is high and retries are increasing.
Olivia: saw the same. KV cache miss rate spiked at 17:12 — looks like a cache eviction storm. Possibly correlated with a rolling restart in ns/frontend earlier. Miss rate: `increase(kv_cache_miss_total[5m])` jumped ~1200.
Ben: PagerDuty shows PD escalation to SRE lead after 5m. @Samir any immediate mitigation we can do that doesn't require a full rollback?
Samir: first mitigation: disable aggressive autoscaler suppression and force a scale up for the eu-west dedicated pool. Running command now: ```bash
# scale up dedicated pool by 30%
redwoodctl scale dedicated --pool model-serving-eu-west --pct 30 --reason "p99 surge"
```
Samir: kicked scale; pods are being added, but warmup takes ~30s per pod so tail will still be noisy for a few mins.
Olivia: starting cache warmup for hotkeys and prefixes to reduce miss storms. Warmup script: ```bash
HOT_KEYS=("user:profile" "embed:recent")
for k in "${HOT_KEYS[@]}"; do curl -s "https://model-serving.eu-west.internal/warm?k=$k" & done
```
pagerduty: P12345 escalated to SRE Lead (Lena) — no response in 5m, auto-escalation initiated.
Ben: alternative/short-term routing: enable fallback to quantized model v2-q8 for eu-west traffic to reduce per-token latency and mem pressure. Command: `redwoodctl rollout --service model-serving --region eu-west --fallback v2-q8 --traffic 30%` — proposing gradual 30% traffic shift. Thoughts?
Olivia: +1 for staged fallback. Quantized variant has slightly lower quality but big tail improvements. We should notify product if rollout >50%.
Samir: initiating 30% fallback now. ```bash
redwoodctl rollout --service model-serving --region eu-west --fallback v2-q8 --traffic 30
```
Samir: also turned on temporary longer KV TTL to avoid churn: `kvctl set-ttl --namespace model-serving 1200s`
Maya (on-call): I'm taking over for post-mitigation monitoring and customer comms. ETA 15m for full handoff. Will coordinate PD updates and follow-up RCA.
Olivia: observing immediate p99 improvement from ~4s -> ~700-900ms after fallback and scale. Miss-rate trending down. Error rate stable (~0.3% from 0.1%), likely due to transient retries during scale.
Ben: customer-impact check — internal report: around 5% of requests in eu-west saw >5s latency window during peak; a handful of customer timeouts (~0.02% of total). We should prepare a brief for support.
Samir: preparing terse PD update: "Mitigations: forced scale + staged fallback to v2-q8 + KV TTL increase. Symptoms reduced; continued monitoring."
pagerduty: note added to P12345 by Samir.
Olivia: throwaway logs showing eviction storm for reference (sanitized): ```text
[17:12:03] pod/frontend-7b9 evicted key=user:1234 proto=LRU
[17:12:04] pod/frontend-7b9 evicted key=embed:xyz proto=LRU
[17:12:09] worker-3a queue_depth=72 retry=1
```
Ben: Suggest follow-ups: 1) check why rolling restart happened in ns/frontend (deploybot logs), 2) consider softer eviction policy or higher pool headroom, 3) add an alert for sudden kv_cache_miss bursts.
Maya (on-call): taking PD update and will add customer-facing note draft. I'll keep watch for 30m and then handoff to next on-call with a summary. Samir — can you drop any runbook links?
Samir: runbook links: https://confluence/model-serving/runbooks/kv-evict and https://confluence/oncall/fallback-rollout. Also added runbook snippet: "If p99 > 2s and kv_cache_miss increases > 50% in 5m: 1) force scale, 2) enable fallback 30% -> 60% if no improvement, 3) warmup hotkeys, 4) raise TTL."
Maya (on-call): thanks. I'll post PD status update and close escalation when stable.
Olivia: monitoring shows p99 stabilizing ~800ms and slo_burn back under 5% for the last 6m.
pagerduty: P12345 status updated to "Mitigated" by Maya (on-call).
Samir: marking thread as mitigated. Will follow up with RCA tomorrow — possible deploybot regression + eviction policy tuning. Handing active watch to Maya.
Maya (on-call): taking watch. Leaving a short action item list in the incident ticket for next shift. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: thread closed for active paging, incident P12345 marked mitigated.
